name: benchkeeper
description: Chooses how much checking a task gets (a software change, a docs pass or research) and sets up and maintains projects. Works next to other skill packs and plugins when they are installed.

tierBand.title: Status band above the prompt (terminal and desktop app)
tierBand.description: Off by default. Adds three rows above the prompt in the Claude Code terminal and desktop app: project, branch and Ponytail's level when it is installed, then the last test run and lint or type check, then the tier of the last answer with buttons that set the tier for this session, open the sessions board and ask the agent to run the doctor. It reads your working folder, git, one Ponytail flag file and the commands and edits of the main loop, keeps the session's tier override in the plugin's own store and sends nothing. Turn it off by setting this option to false. The VS Code extension does not draw it.

statusStyle.title: What BenchKeeper's status line prints (accounts with usage tracking)
statusStyle.description: merged (default): the usage windows and Ponytail's level. plugin: Ponytail's level only. benchkeeper: the usage windows only. none: nothing. Any other value counts as merged. The usage windows are recorded in every style. Applies only where benchkeeper accounts track installed the status line.

rotateAtTokens.title: Clear an idle coordinator above this many context tokens
rotateAtTokens.description: 200000 by default; 0 turns it off while rotateAtPercent is also 0. Applies only to a session in an Orca terminal whose project folder (where Claude Code started) holds the handoff file of /benchkeeper:orchestrating-projects (.benchkeeper/runs/handoff.md) and whose file names that terminal (a Terminal: line). When such a coordinator ends a turn with no background task running and its context is above this size, the plugin clears it with /clear and submits a prompt that resumes it from the file; after a clear or compaction it hands the file back. At most one clear every 10 minutes. Without the file nothing happens.

rotateAtPercent.title: Clear an idle coordinator above this percent of the context window
rotateAtPercent.description: 0 (default) is off and rotateAtTokens applies. Above 0, an idle coordinator that keeps the handoff file of /benchkeeper:orchestrating-projects is cleared with /clear and resumed from the file once its context fills this percent of the model's context window, in place of rotateAtTokens.
